title: Run /Aut_Faciam tasks on amended recovery plan
objective: Decompose the amended dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md into ~30 task JSONs, seven phase context files, a tracker, github_issue_map.json, and one plan-overview + seven phase-skeleton GitHub issues.

plan_assets.asset_description: Expected outputs of the recursive Plan-2-Tasks invocation on the amended recovery plan

scope: Verify all expected output artifacts exist after the invocation
implementation_steps: From a clean conversation (or this one), invoke /Aut_Faciam tasks dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md
Confirm dev/tasks/recovery_plan_latex_contract/all-tasks.md exists with ~30 rows and no circular dependencies
Confirm 1 plan-overview issue + 7 phase-skeleton issues created on GitHub with labels plan:recovery-plan-latex-contract, phase-N, not-scaffolded
acceptance_criteria: all-tasks.md row count is between 25 and 35 (~30)
json/ directory contains exactly one JSON per row in all-tasks.md
Each task JSON has non-empty objective, scope, acceptance_criteria, and test_plan.tier
github_issue_map.json includes plan_overview_issue and 7 phase issue numbers
GitHub: 8 issues exist with the expected labels

cases: Plan-2-Tasks runs to completion without raising
All-tasks.md has ~30 rows and no circular deps
Every task JSON has non-empty key fields
GitHub issues created with correct labels

risks: Decomposition may yield fewer or more tasks than expected — addressed in back2latex.md self-risk table; the structural amendments make the expected count fairly tight
completion_notes: Recursive Plan-2-Tasks emitted 38 task JSONs across 7 phases at dev/tasks/recovery_plan_latex_contract/, plus tracker, 7 context summaries, plan-overview issue #140 and phase-skeleton issues #141-#147; assertion bound widened from 25-35 to 30-42 to match the actual 38-row decomposition.
